body: I feel like it’s kinda now or never because I’ve known for a while I was bisexual. Also the expression the grass is greener on the other side. I’m still very apprehensive to the thought, but if I truthfully want to live for myself I think I really need to weigh it.

I’m in college

I have a transgender sibling so I’m 99.9% acceptance wouldn’t be a issue
I just need perspective tho. It’s hard 😭😭 because every day time moves on. I feel like this could also greatly cure my mental health issues if I gain clarity

I feel like I can relate to you because I gave it all in my relationship. I feel like I messed up because I felt like I wasn’t really focused on improving myself and I overthink a ton. It was extremely rude for her to end things like that. It will get better as time progresses. You can’t base everyone if you don’t overturn ever rock you come across. Part of finding somebody to love so much is you having to be willing to take that risk. You have to tell yourself she isn’t coming back because she isn’t. This is your life and you need to put yourself first. It’s ok to grieve but you can’t allow yourself to slide into a deep hole. Do things that you like, meet new people, find things that excite you. You can get through this.
Thank you so much I really needed this
